alex_cs: Heads-up — Ecoline onboarding seeing bursts of 429s when they scale warmers. They ramped from ~8 -> ~90 concurrent invocations.

alex_cs: customer code (python):
```
# per-request token
token = requests.post('https://auth.ecoline.app/token').json()['token']
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat', headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}'}, json=body)
```

remy_se: ephemeral token per invocation + no session reuse = stampede. Ask if auth returns ttl and if they can add a small token cache.

alex_cs: auth returns {"token":"...","ttl":40}. They've no socket pooling.

jin_engineer: Recommend: 1) in-process token cache (ttl-5s) 2) use requests.Session() to reuse TCP/TLS 3) add randomized splay on init (sleep random 0-1s). Small code example sent.

jin_engineer: quick python snippet: 
```
_session = requests.Session(); _cache={'t':None,'e':0}
def get_token():
  if time.time() < _cache['e']-5: return _cache['t']
  r = requests.post('https://auth.ecoline.app/token'); d=r.json(); _cache.update({'t':d['token'],'e':time.time()+d['ttl']}); return _cache['t']
```

alex_cs: they tested in staging — 429s dropped from 9% -> 0.7% in 12 minutes. Will rollout canary 10% now.

remy_se: on our side ops can open a 15min mitigation to relax hard 429s for this tenant while they ramp if we detect header `x-client-token-cache: true`. ops?

ops_bot: mitigation ticket #CS-5077 created. owner=jin_engineer expires_in=15m playbook=token-cache-grace

alex_cs: customer also asked for a telemetry hint from our gateway when we see many auth checks. jin, can we add an opt-in header like `x-token-pressure: high`?

jin_engineer: doable as a feature flag; will prototype. Logging this in product feedback for renewal notes.

alex_cs: will monitor canary and update. closing if stable in 24h.
